Subject: Priority response framework & renewal — premium SLA proposal

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time last week. As Pioneer approaches its year-3 renewal, I wanted to put a concise proposal on the table that addresses two asks you raised: 1) guaranteed lower tail latency for peak hours, and 2) faster triage + response for incidents during promotional event windows.

What we propose (summary):
- Premium SLA addendum: 99.95% uptime + 95th percentile latency SLO of 120ms for your primary inference routes during US peak windows (8am–8pm PDT).
- Priority response framework: dedicated escalation routing to a named on-call engineer, 30-minute P1 acknowledgement, and a weekly ops sync during the first 60 days post-renewal.
- Capacity uplift: baseline reserved capacity + 2.5x burst pool for Black Friday–style traffic surges; automatic fallback to compatible quantized model variants if capacity is exhausted.

Attached is a draft SOW and a pricing worksheet showing the uplift options. High-level commercial options: 12-month term with the premium SLA add-on (recommended) or a 24-month term that includes a modest discount and prioritized capacity guarantees.

Next steps I suggest:
1) If this looks directionally right, can we set a 30-minute alignment call with procurement and your engineering ops lead?
2) I’ll loop in Logan (pricing) to surface the final numbers prior to your procurement review.

If helpful, I can also prepare a short runbook excerpt that describes automatic fallback behavior and monitoring hooks we will add to the console for Pioneer.

Thanks —

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear summary. High level sounds like exactly what our Ops and engineering leads asked for. A few quick clarifying Qs before I bring this to procurement: 

- Can you confirm whether the 120ms SLO applies per-request for conversational generation endpoints or only to short prompt inference routes? We surface different tail behaviors for long context jobs.
- For the priority response framework, will Pioneer get a named phone line / PagerDuty escalate and who covers on-call rotations during federal holidays?
- Procurement will want any SOC2 attestations and evidence of KMS integration for customer-managed keys in the private deployment plan.

Budget note: Our finance team is pushing for a mid-June signature window and would prefer a 12-month term if we can avoid a 20% uplift to list. There may be room for trade-offs (e.g., longer billing cycle or a small committed token floor).

Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week with procurement? I’ll include our procurement rep (procurement@pioneerretail.com) on the call invite once we lock time.

Thanks,

Samantha Brown
Head of Product Ops, Pioneer Retail
samantha.brown@pioneerretail.com

Jonas / Logan —

Quick internal note before we jump on the call with Pioneer next week. Answers to Samantha’s Qs and our recommended positioning: 

1) 120ms SLO scope: applies to standard short-context generation routes (prompt lengths <= 1k tokens). For long-context jobs (>1k tokens) we should offer a separate tiered SLO (e.g., 250ms 95th) — call that out as an exception in the SOW.

2) Incident routing: we’ll provide a named on-call engineer and a dedicated PagerDuty escalation policy. Holidays are covered by our expanded rotation for premium customers (we bill an on-call holiday premium if Pioneer wants guaranteed holiday coverage). Suggest we offer 2 holiday weeks included per year and bill for additional holiday coverage.

3) Security evidence: attach SOC 2 Type II summary link + KMS integration checklist. Per precedent, we can return a redacted SOC document and provide KMS integration runbook for on-prem/VPC customers. Procurement usually accepts the redacted artifact plus KMS attestation.

Commercial suggestion: present a 12-month renewable term with the premium SLA add-on at +14% ARR uplift vs current spend, or a 24-month term at +7% ARR uplift with a 6% prepay discount. Lean toward the 12-month to keep renewal cadence tight and provide Pioneer optionality on committed volume adjustments.

I’ve attached a calibrated pricing worksheet. Logan — please review the numbers and flag anything that needs Legal input before the call.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
